;WITH TotalSucursale AS
(
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Numărul total de sucursale
    -------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSucursale
    FROM app.Sucursala
),

ConfigurareBanci AS
(
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Denumirea băncii
    -------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(bc.CodBanca)) AS CodBanca,
        MAX(LTRIM(RTRIM(bc.DenumireBanca))) AS DenumireBanca
    FROM app.BancaCard bc
    WHERE bc.CodBanca IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        LTRIM(RTRIM(bc.CodBanca))
),

ConfigurareTipPlata AS
(
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Codul sursă aferent tipului de plată
    -------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(tpc.TipPlata)) AS TipPlata,
        MAX(LTRIM(RTRIM(tpc.Cod))) AS CodSursa
    FROM app.TipPlataCard tpc
    WHERE tpc.TipPlata IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        LTRIM(RTRIM(tpc.TipPlata))
),

GrupuriCentralizare AS
(
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Fișierele transmise de sucursale
    -- Se preiau numai înregistrările cu Status = 4
    -------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        bft.Anul,
        bft.Luna,

        CONVERT(date, bft.DataPlatii) AS DataPlatii,

        LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.CodBanca)) AS CodBanca,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.TipPlata)) AS TipPlata,

        COUNT
        (
            DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.CodSucursala))
        ) AS NumarSucursale,

        COUNT(*) AS NumarFisiereSucursale,

        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(bft.NumarSalariati, 0)
        ) AS NumarSalariati,

        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(bft.ValoareTotala, 0)
        ) AS ValoareTotala,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Concatenarea FileId-urilor sursă
        -------------------------------------------------
        STRING_AGG
        (
            CONVERT(nvarchar(max), bft.FileId),
            ';'
        ) WITHIN GROUP
        (
            ORDER BY bft.FileId
        ) AS FileIds

    FROM app.BancaFisierTransfer bft

    WHERE bft.Status = 4
      AND bft.FileId IS NOT NULL
      AND bft.Luna = @Luna
      AND bft.Anul = @Anul

    GROUP BY
        bft.Anul,
        bft.Luna,
        CONVERT(date, bft.DataPlatii),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.CodBanca)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.TipPlata))
),

SucursaleLipsa AS
(
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Lista codurilor sucursalelor care nu au transmis
    -------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        gc.Anul,
        gc.Luna,
        gc.DataPlatii,
        gc.CodBanca,
        gc.TipPlata,

        STRING_AGG
        (
            CONVERT
            (
                nvarchar(max),
                LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodSucursala))
            ),
            ','
        ) WITHIN GROUP
        (
            ORDER BY LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodSucursala))
        ) AS ListaSucursaleLipsa

    FROM GrupuriCentralizare gc

    CROSS JOIN app.Sucursala s

    WHERE NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM app.BancaFisierTransfer bft

        WHERE bft.Status = 4
          AND bft.FileId IS NOT NULL

          AND bft.Anul = gc.Anul
          AND bft.Luna = gc.Luna

          AND CONVERT(date, bft.DataPlatii)
              = gc.DataPlatii

          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.CodBanca))
              = gc.CodBanca

          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.TipPlata))
              = gc.TipPlata

          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.CodSucursala))
              = LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodSucursala))
    )

    GROUP BY
        gc.Anul,
        gc.Luna,
        gc.DataPlatii,
        gc.CodBanca,
        gc.TipPlata
),

SursaInsert AS
(
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Pregătirea datelor pentru inserare
    -------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY gc.DataPlatii
            ORDER BY
                gc.CodBanca,
                gc.TipPlata
        ) AS IdCentr,

        gc.Anul,
        gc.Luna,
        gc.DataPlatii,
        gc.CodBanca,

        ISNULL
        (
            cb.DenumireBanca,
            gc.CodBanca
        ) AS DenumireBanca,

        gc.TipPlata,

        ISNULL
        (
            ctp.CodSursa,
            gc.TipPlata
        ) AS CodSursa,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- CNPR_<CodBanca>_<CodSursa>_<ddMMyy>
        -- Extensia se adaugă în workflow
        -------------------------------------------------
        'CNPR_'
        + UPPER(gc.CodBanca)
        + '_'
        + UPPER
        (
            ISNULL
            (
                ctp.CodSursa,
                gc.TipPlata
            )
        )
        + '_'
        + FORMAT
        (
            gc.DataPlatii,
            'ddMMyy'
        ) AS DenumireFisier,

        gc.NumarSucursale,
        gc.NumarFisiereSucursale,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.NumarSucursale = ts.TotalSucursale
                THEN ''
            ELSE
                ISNULL(sl.ListaSucursaleLipsa, '')
            END AS SucursaleLipsa,
        gc.NumarSalariati,
        gc.ValoareTotala,
        gc.FileIds,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Complet
        -------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN gc.NumarSucursale = ts.TotalSucursale
                THEN CAST(1 AS bit)
            ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)
        END AS Complet,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Exemplu: 7 / 10
        -------------------------------------------------
        CONVERT(nvarchar(20), gc.NumarSucursale)
        + ' / '
        + CONVERT(nvarchar(20), ts.TotalSucursale)
            AS Completitudine,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Detalii complete / sucursale lipsă
        -------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN gc.NumarSucursale = ts.TotalSucursale
                THEN N'Complet'
            ELSE
                N'Lipsesc: '
                + ISNULL(sl.ListaSucursaleLipsa, N'')
        END AS DetaliiComplet

    FROM GrupuriCentralizare gc

    CROSS JOIN TotalSucursale ts

    LEFT JOIN ConfigurareBanci cb
        ON cb.CodBanca = gc.CodBanca

    LEFT JOIN ConfigurareTipPlata ctp
        ON ctp.TipPlata = gc.TipPlata

    LEFT JOIN SucursaleLipsa sl
        ON sl.Anul = gc.Anul
       AND sl.Luna = gc.Luna
       AND sl.DataPlatii = gc.DataPlatii
       AND sl.CodBanca = gc.CodBanca
       AND sl.TipPlata = gc.TipPlata
)

-------------------------------------------------
-- INSERT Centralizare CNPR
-------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO app.BancaFisierTransferCNPR
(
    IdCentr,

    Anul,
    Luna,
    DataPlatii,

    CodBanca,
    DenumireBanca,

    TipPlata,
    CodSursa,

    DenumireFisier,

    NumarSucursale,
    NumarFisisereSucursale,
    SucursaleLipsa,
    NumarSalariati,
    ValoareTotala,

    Complet,
    Completitudine,

    FileIds,

    Status,

    CreatedDate
)

SELECT
    s.IdCentr,

    s.Anul,
    s.Luna,
    s.DataPlatii,

    s.CodBanca,
    s.DenumireBanca,

    s.TipPlata,
    s.CodSursa,

    s.DenumireFisier,

    s.NumarSucursale,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- În entitate câmpul este:
    -- NumarFisisereSucursale
    -------------------------------------------------
    s.NumarFisiereSucursale,
    s.SucursaleLipsa,

    s.NumarSalariati,
    s.ValoareTotala,

    s.Complet,
    s.Completitudine,

    s.FileIds,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- 1 = Draft
    -------------------------------------------------
    1 AS Status,

    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AS CreatedDate

FROM SursaInsert s

WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM app.BancaFisierTransferCNPR bft

    WHERE bft.Anul = s.Anul
      AND bft.Luna = s.Luna

      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.CodBanca))
          = LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodBanca))

      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(bft.TipPlata))
          = LTRIM(RTRIM(s.TipPlata))

      AND CONVERT(date, bft.DataPlatii)
          = CONVERT(date, s.DataPlatii)
);
